from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document, e.g., '《判决文书 X》'")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
